cards.text: Friend, this word of the LORD comes to a man named Zephaniah son of Cushi, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah. The text even names four of Zephaniah's ancestors, all the way back to Hezekiah. Me? The only family history I came with was a 25-cent price sticker from a bin at a bakery that was closing.
Then the LORD speaks. He declares He will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth.

cards.question: The LORD names what He will sweep away: man and beast, the birds and the fish. True or false: He also names the idols with their wicked worshipers.

cards.text: Then the LORD gets closer to home: He says He will stretch out His hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. You know when you're nodding along to a warning and suddenly realize it's about YOU?

cards.question: Along with every remnant of Baal, a false god, the LORD says He will cut off from this place the names of the idolatrous and pagan ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD describes who He means. Some people bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven.

cards.question: Others bow down and swear by the LORD. What does the LORD say is the problem with these people?

cards.text: Swearing by the LORD and by Milcom, a false god, is like wearing two team jerseys to the same game and hoping NOBODY notices. Then the LORD names one more group: those who turn back from following the LORD.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says those who turn back from following Him still seek Him and inquire of Him.

cards.text: Then the voice shifts, and the call is to be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer counting dust, and even I can tell this is a whole different level of quiet.

cards.question: Why the call to be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD?

answers.text: The Day of the LORD is near
The king of Judah has died

cards.text: Then comes a striking line. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice, and He has consecrated His guests.

cards.question: On the Day of the LORD's sacrifice, who does the LORD name first for punishment?

answers.text: The princes and the sons of the king
The soldiers at the city gates

cards.question: True or false: after the princes and the sons of the king, the LORD also names all who are dressed in foreign apparel for punishment on the Day of the LORD's sacrifice.

cards.text: The LORD isn't done naming names. On that day, He says, He will punish all who leap over the threshold.

cards.question: The LORD says the people who leap over the threshold fill their master's house with what?

cards.text: The LORD keeps going. On that day, He says, a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.

cards.question: Then the call goes out for the dwellers of the Hollow to wail. Why?

answers.text: Their wells will all run dry
Their king will be taken away

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will search Jerusalem with lamps. Back in the junk drawer I would have LOVED somebody coming through with a lamp, but friend, this is not that kind of search.

cards.question: The LORD says He will punish the men in Jerusalem settled in complacency. What do they say to themselves?

answers.text: The LORD will do nothing either good or bad
The LORD will protect us no matter what
The LORD only judges the other nations

cards.text: So the LORD says what happens to them. Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says these complacent men will build houses and get to live in them.

cards.text: They'll build houses but not live in them, and plant vineyards but never drink the wine. That's like working overtime all year for a vacation and NEVER getting to take it.
Then the call comes: the great Day of the LORD is near, near and coming quickly. This is one warning NOBODY gets to hit snooze on.

cards.question: True or false: on the Day of the LORD, the mighty will stand strong and unshaken.
Then comes a list of what that day will be, one line after another. Which of these is on the list?

answers.text: A day of darkness and gloom
A day of famine and drought
A day of plague and sickness

cards.question: True or false: that day will also be a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will bring such distress on mankind that it changes even the way people walk. And He says why.

cards.question: The LORD says people will walk like the ___, because they have ___ against the LORD.

cards.text: The LORD says their blood will be poured out like dust. Then He names the thing people lean on when trouble shows up.

cards.question: What does the LORD say won't be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD's wrath?

cards.text: The LORD says the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy. Then the last line says He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth, and friend, I think that's a heavy one.
